parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, typically made of stainless steel. It is circular and slightly domed to fit securely on the pot.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, helping to cook food evenly and efficiently.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can be lifted or placed on the pot; it is detachable and does not have any mechanical movement.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of stainless steel with a cylindrical shape and flat bottom.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the food and liquid during cooking, providing the main volume for heat transfer and cooking processes.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is stationary during use, though it can be lifted or moved as a whole when handling the pot.
